selection_rule.name: one_standard_error_with_parsimony
selection_rule.standard_error_source: Sample standard deviation of the best-log-loss candidate's three fold Log Loss values divided by sqrt(3).

metric_definitions.pooled_metrics: Calculated once across all 135 disjoint validation predictions so every validation match has equal weight.
metric_definitions.multiclass_brier_score: Mean over validation matches of the sum across H, D, and A of (observed_one_hot - predicted_probability) squared; unscaled range 0 to 2, lower is better.
metric_definitions.fold_metric_population_standard_deviatio: Population standard deviation across the three fold metrics.
metric_definitions.fold_metric_sample_standard_deviation: Sample standard deviation across the three fold metrics.
metric_definitions.fold_metric_standard_error: Sample standard deviation across the three fold metrics divided by the square root of three.
